reviews.title: 5 Star Performance, 3 Star Price!
reviews.comment: There’s no denying that this card is a monster performer for gaming. I recently moved to a 32” 4k monitor from 1080p, and knew that this expenditure was a must in order to play games with all the eye candy turned on. It will not disappoint! I’m not a competitive gamer looking for 500fps, but usually setup games to play at lowest frame rates possible where the game plays smoothly using highest quality settings, which is usually between 80-100 fps. Using that formula, I get an incredible gaming experience, while keeping GPU temps in the mid 45-55c range, and at that temp, the fans spool around 1000rpm, so it is extremely quiet. So far, I am really pleased with the cooling capability with this card, in fact it cools so quickly that the fans will immediately shut off as soon as you exit gameplay. This card is the sweet spot for 4k, and would probably guess it’s almost overkill for most 1440p gamers. I would highly recommend the TUF Gaming version over any other 4080S card, simply for the build quality and reliability of this card. Hope you found this helpful in your pursuit of ultimate gaming!

reviews.title: Great card.
reviews.comment: OMG, this is a great video card, as it should be for the price. I would suggest people wait and get this on a sale if they can. It was easy to install and setup, no problems there. It also looks great. Be aware of the size, it is big and may not fit into some smaller cases. Its heavy and seems very well manufactured. I would highly recommend this supplier. The card blew away my 5060ti.
reviews.author: Brian B.

reviews.title: Huge card!
reviews.comment: This is one massive card! Take a look at the pic for a comparison against my outgoing 3080. Came perfectly packaged and though the courier ran into a few delays at customs, it finally came through just fine. I didn’t really expect it to be this huge though and it’s good that I have a Lancool 3 tower. Chucked aside the bundled 12VHPWR adapter and opted for a Cablemod one. I went with the 3X pcie plug version as that was what the adapter also came with. Saw some reviews that Seasonic PSU’s only need 2x pcie plugs, but I played it safe. Only gripe is that Aura RGB doesn’t seem to synch with the graphics card for some reason. It comes with a pretty nice looking gpu stand and it’s quite helpful to prevent sag. The card runs super silent and the fans hardly spin up unless there’s some heavy RT load. Super efficient though.
